items.new: It was a black and hooded head; and hanging there in the midst of so intense a calm, it seemed like the Sphynx's in the desert. "Speak, you vast and venerable head," muttered Ahab, "you who, though you have no beard, yet here and there look hoary with mosses; speak, mighty head, and tell us the secret thing that is in you. Of all divers, you have dived the deepest. That head upon which the upper sun now gleams has moved among this world's foundations. Where unrecorded names and navies rust, and untold hopes and anchors rot; where in her murderous hold this frigate earth is ballasted with the bones of millions of the drowned; there, in that awful water-land, there was your most familiar home. You have been where diving-bell or diver never went; you have slept by many a sailor's side, where sleepless mothers would give their lives to lay them down. You saw the locked lovers when they leaped from their flaming ship; heart to heart they sank beneath the exulting wave; true to each other, when heaven seemed false to them. You saw the murdered mate when pirates tossed him from the midnight deck; for hours he fell into the deeper midnight of the insatiable maw; and his murderers still sailed on unharmed — while swift lightning shattered the neighboring ship that would have carried a righteous husband to outstretched, longing arms. O head! you have seen enough to split the planets and make an infidel of Abraham, and not one syllable is yours!"

items.new: So strongly and metaphysically did I conceive of my situation then that, while earnestly watching his motions, I seemed distinctly to perceive that my own individuality was now merged in a joint-stock company of two; that my free will had received a mortal wound; and that another's mistake or misfortune might plunge innocent me into undeserved disaster and death. Therefore, I saw that here was a sort of interregnum in Providence; for its even-handed fairness never could have allowed so gross an injustice. And yet, still further pondering — while I jerked him now and then from between the whale and the ship, which threatened to jam him — still further pondering, I say, I saw that this situation of mine was the precise situation of every mortal that breathes; only, in most cases, he, one way or another, has this Siamese connection with a plurality of other mortals. If your banker breaks, you snap; if your apothecary by mistake sends you poison in your pills, you die. True, you may say that by exceeding caution you may possibly escape these and the countless other evil chances of life. But however carefully I handled Queequeg's monkey-rope, sometimes he jerked it so that I came very near sliding overboard. Nor could I possibly forget that, whatever I did, I had the management of only one end of it.*

"if peradventure he had needed it" (if by chance) lost "by chance"; "they most piously do pounce" became "most devoutly descend", losing the predatory "pounce" that the vulture image needs; the apostrophe "Oh, horrible vultureism of earth!" lost "Oh".
items.new: Here is a most doleful and most mocking funeral! The sea-vultures all in pious mourning, the air-sharks all punctiliously dressed in black or speckled. In life, few of them would have helped the whale, I think, if by chance he had needed it. But upon the banquet of his funeral they most piously pounce. Oh, horrible vultureism of earth! From which not even the mightiest whale is free.
